tr.text: Merhaba, bugün hava açık ve sakin.
Üç küçük kuş ağacın üzerinde ötüyor.
Dün akşam yağmur kısa süre yağdı.
Lütfen şu üç öğeyi sırayla okuyun.
Şekerli çayı değil, sade kahveyi seçtim.
Yarın için iki ayrı seçenek var.
Teşekkür ederim; başka bir isteğiniz var mı?

en.text: Hello, the weather is clear and calm today.
The desk is beside the window.
The light switch is to the left of the door.
Three small birds are singing in the tree.
The appointment starts at 2:30 p.m.
The meeting is on October 9, 2026.
The reference number is 0482; please note it.
The measurement is 3.75 centimeters.
The flowers around that corner are lovely.
It rained briefly yesterday evening.
The library opens at eight o'clock.
We took the train from Boston to Portland.
Please read these three items in order.
The contact number is 212-555-0186.
We can go for a walk this afternoon.
A small change has been saved.
I chose plain coffee, not sweet tea.
The ticket costs one hundred twenty-five dollars and fifty cents.
There are two different options for tomorrow.
Thank you. Is there anything else you need?
